description: Commercial validation bands for the historical four-week exercise. These are business assumptions, not proven thresholds. Change them as evidence accumulates.
good_opportunity_definition: Opportunities in the HIGH or MEDIUM score band that were delivered (not suppressed).

bands.verdict: Average 15+ good opportunities per week — enough weekly volume to justify a paid weekly feed.
8-14 per week — commercially plausible, needs supplier feedback on quality before scaling.
4-7 per week — thin. Either widen the qualification rules or reconsider the weekly cadence.
Fewer than 4 per week — trade mark activity alone does not surface enough emerging food brands. Rethink the signal or the product.

volume_guardrails.note: Used by the fail-closed safety checks. A journal outside these bounds blocks sending and raises an alert.
